name: Evil in Time
source:
The year is 2043. Evil Neuro is caught between an AI empire and a human resistance fighting for their survival. In this visual novel, you can travel back in time with Evil as she relives the choices made during some of Neuro-sama's best streams of 2023 and 2024. Every subtle choice can affect how Neuro's personality develops over the ages. Make the right choice at the right time, and you can change the course of the future. 

But don't make Vedal too suspicious! And you may not be the only one who's been sent back through time...

[From [url=https://theashywolf.itch.io/evil-in-time]itch.io[/url]]
